uptake of organic compounds is a complex process involving both apoplastic and symplastic transport pathways.

the uptake of organic pollutants by rice roots is achieved via two pathways: the symplastic and apoplastic pathway; and the contribution of the two pathways to uptake depends on the type of organic compounds.
